newsitem.title: USA: Merisel says in talks to restructure debt.
newsitem.headline: Merisel says in talks to restructure debt.

text.p: Merisel Inc on Monday said it has entered talks to restructure its $125 million in 12.5 percent senior notes, due 2004, by converting the debt to common stock.
In addition, the company is seeking an extension on the final maturity of the debt, which is due in January 1998.

"Merisel can only achieve long-term profitability if the company's debt levels can be reduced significantly," Dwight Steffensen, chief executive officer, said in a statement. " As of December 31, Merisel's debt totaled roughly $300 million, excluding asset securitized debt.
